_: Which arena a roleplay map's fights are held on, where a capture has measured it.
The rule in MapManager.ResolveArenaMapId works the arena out - same subarea, (0,0), the
arena flag, a small id offset - and it is right for Astrub and Incarnam, where it was
checked. It is wrong for the kanojedos: the Amakna one at 99090957 fights on 99222029,
an offset of 131,072, which no small-delta rule finds, so the resolver fell back to
'any arena of the subarea' and picked one by hash. Anything written here wins over the
rule, and is read off a capture: the jru that follows the fight's start names the arena,
and the jru that follows its end names the map you are put back on.

arenas.measured: 4 starts and 5 returns across Clases/Hipermago, Clases/Zurkarak and four Combate captures
6 starts and 7 returns across the Clases/Ocra captures
14 starts and 20 returns across the Clases captures
3 starts and 4 returns across the Clases captures
